title: Ruleset
description: A user's rule set: the document that is imported, exported, synced and enforced. `timeZone` pins the zone every schedule, bedtime and budget day is evaluated in (the device zone is never an input). `pendingTimeZone` is set only while a time-zone change waits (both zones apply, the stricter wins). `workHours` is the user's working hours, which rules opt into with `{ "ref": "workHours" }`. Strict: unknown fields are rejected, keys are unique (`x-uniqueBy`) and the serialised document must not exceed 256 KB.

revision.description: Monotonic, assigned by whoever edits the set.
